parameters.query:
=INSERT INTO job_hunter_jobs (title, company, url, source, location, status, found_at)
VALUES (
  '{{String($json.title || '').replace(/'/g, "''")}}',
  '{{String($json.company || '').replace(/'/g, "''")}}',
  '{{String($json.url || '').replace(/'/g, "''")}}',
  '{{String($json.source || '').replace(/'/g, "''")}}',
  '{{String($json.location || '').replace(/'/g, "''")}}',
  'FOUND',
  NOW()
)
ON CONFLICT (url) DO NOTHING
RETURNING *, '{{String($json.snippet || '').replace(/'/g, "''")}}' AS snippet;

parameters.query:
=UPDATE job_hunter_jobs
SET full_job_text = '{{String($json.full_job_text || '').replace(/'/g, "''")}}',
    english_required = {{$json.english_required ? 'true' : 'false'}},
    english_preferred = {{$json.english_preferred ? 'true' : 'false'}},
    bilingual_required = {{$json.bilingual_required ? 'true' : 'false'}},
    decision = 'FAIL',
    validation_reason = '{{String($json.prefilter_decision === 'REJECT' ? 'Hard pre-filter found English/bilingual requirement or preference' : 'Full description unavailable or insufficient').replace(/'/g, "''")}}',
    validation_evidence = '{{JSON.stringify($json.english_prefilter_evidence || []).replace(/'/g, "''")}}'::jsonb,
    english_certification = '{{JSON.stringify($json.english_certification || {}).replace(/'/g, "''")}}'::jsonb,
    extraction_status = '{{String($json.extraction_status || '').replace(/'/g, "''")}}',
    status = CASE WHEN '{{String($json.prefilter_decision)}}' = 'REJECT' THEN 'REJECTED' ELSE 'NEEDS_REVIEW' END,
    validated_at = NOW()
WHERE url = '{{String($json.url || '').replace(/'/g, "''")}}'
RETURNING *;
